The Subtask Name: FileSurfer Transcription Attempt
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: FileSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.86
  agent_explanation: Orchestrator instructed FileSurfer to open and listen to the local audio file “1f975693-876d-457b-a649-393859e79bf3.mp3” to extract page numbers (e.g., “Please listen to the audio file...”).
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Reissuing the same instruction when FileSurfer lacks capability to actually play/parse audio in this setup.
      severity: 0.80
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Orchestrator keeps sending identical commands without changing approach.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: FileSurfer will repeatedly return no new information, reinforcing a loop.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Over-reliance on a single tool that cannot produce the needed transcript.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: Critical time wasted on a non-viable path.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: FileSurfer cannot progress and will keep failing with the same error.

- From_agent: FileSurfer
  To_agent: Orchestrator
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.71
  agent_explanation: FileSurfer repeatedly surfaced the same result view, reporting the audio duration and “Error. Could not transcribe this audio.” after attempting access.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: If the error is misreported or transient, it might mask partial or alternate access methods.
      severity: 0.35
      if_from_agent_wrong: Orchestrator assumes no transcription is possible at all.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator may prematurely abandon viable recovery options.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Repeated identical feedback without proposing alternatives.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: No forward signals for pivoting tools.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Orchestrator keeps iterating the same command.

- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: FileSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: loop_control
  agent_strength: 0.83
  agent_explanation: After the first failure, Orchestrator re-issued the same “Please play…” and “Please listen…” instructions multiple times, as noted in ledgers calling out the loop.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Reinforcement of a non-productive loop when conditions are unchanged.
      severity: 0.90
      if_from_agent_wrong: Orchestrator fails to introduce a new tool or method.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: FileSurfer continues to return the same error output with no progress.
